# Severe system-wide freezes and SteamVR crashes following recent updates

Ever since the past few updates, I and several other users have been experiencing severe system-wide freezes while playing VRChat.

These freezes involve:

- Complete loss of mouse and keyboard responsiveness.

- Looping audio within VRChat.

- The entire Windows desktop becoming unresponsive.

- Freezes lasting upwards of two minutes.

- Occasional complete SteamVR crashes.

- In severe cases, having to forcibly power off the computer.

The freezes frequently occur when loading avatars or turning my head in populated instances.

There also appears to be a potential correlation with VRAM usage. My dedicated VRAM usage typically sits between 3 and 4.5 GB while running SteamVR, but increases to approximately 7.5 GB out of 8 GB after launching VRChat.

Reducing background VRAM consumption has improved some minor stuttering but has not resolved the severe system-wide freezes.

Other demanding games run without exhibiting these symptoms, even while streaming.

In the five years I've played VRChat, I've never experienced anywhere near as many severe freezes and complete VR crashes as I have over the past few weeks. This represents a significant regression in performance and stability compared to my previous experience.

The issue has become severe enough to interrupt live streams and make regular gameplay unreliable.

**System specifications:**

- CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 5700X3D

- GPU: NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti (8 GB VRAM)

- RAM: 64 GB DDR4

- Storage: SSD

- OS: Windows 10

- Headset: Meta Quest 2

- VR streaming software: Virtual Desktop

- VR runtime: SteamVR

I cannot confirm the underlying cause, but given the timing of these issues and the number of other users reporting similar symptoms, I strongly suspect a regression introduced by a recent update.

Please prioritize investigating this issue, as it is significantly affecting the usability and stability of the platform.
title: Hard lag spikes, desktop freezes, and full Steam VR ecosystem crash
